warning_issue.title_en: Strong Winds and Rough Seas Warning

heading_en: Warning on Strong Wind and Rough Seas
text_en: SECTION A: FOR MALAYSIAN WATERS [WITHIN 24 NAUTICAL MILES] 1) THUNDERSTORMS WARNING Thunderstorms, heavy rain and strong winds are expected over the waters of Perlis & Kedah • Kelantan • Sarawak • Sabah until 5:00 AM; Sunday, 1 November 2026. This condition may cause strong winds up to 50 kmph and rough seas with wave height up to 3.5 metres and is dangerous to small boats. SECTION B: FOR SHIPPING 1) THUNDERSTORMS WARNING Thunderstorms, heavy rain and strong winds are expected over the waters of Labuan • Bunguran • Eastern part of Condore • Reef North • Layang-Layang • Reef South • Eastern part of Phuket • Samui • Palawan • Sulu until 5:00 AM; Sunday, 1 November 2026. This condition may cause strong winds up to 50 kmph and rough seas with wave height up to 3.5 metres and is dangerous to small boats.
instruction_en: This condition of strong winds and rough seas is dangerous.
heading_bm: Amaran Angin kencang dan laut bergelora
text_bm: SEKSYEN A: UNTUK PERAIRAN MALAYSIA [DALAM LINGKUNGAN 24 BATU NAUTIKA] 1) AMARAN RIBUT PETIR Ribut petir, hujan lebat dan angin kencang dijangka di kawasan perairan Perlis & Kedah • Kelantan • Sarawak • Sabah sehingga 5:00 Pagi; Ahad, 1 November 2026. Keadaan ini boleh menyebabkan angin kencang sehingga 50 kmsj dan laut bergelora dengan ombak mencapai ketinggian 3.5 meter dan berbahaya kepada bot-bot kecil. SEKSYEN B: UNTUK PERKAPALAN 1) AMARAN RIBUT PETIR Ribut petir, hujan lebat dan angin kencang dijangka di kawasan perairan Labuan • Bunguran • Timur Condore • Reef North • Layang-Layang • Reef South • Timur Phuket • Samui • Palawan • Sulu sehingga 5:00 Pagi; Ahad, 1 November 2026. Keadaan ini boleh menyebabkan angin kencang sehingga 50 kmsj dan laut bergelora dengan ombak mencapai ketinggian 3.5 meter dan berbahaya kepada bot-bot kecil.
instruction_bm: Keadaan angin kencang dan laut bergelora ini adalah berbahaya.

text_en: Thunderstorms, heavy rain and strong winds are expected over the states of Pahang (Cameron Highlands) • Sarawak: Miri, Sri Aman (Sri Aman and Lubok Antu), Limbang, Kapit (Kapit and Song), Sarikei (Julau and Pakan), Sibu (Kanowit and Selangau), Bintulu, Mukah (Mukah) • Sabah: Interior (Sipitang, Beaufort and Kuala Penyu) • W.P. Labuan until 2:00 AM; Sunday, 1 November 2026.
